name: Soyuz-7
about: Soyuz-7 (1969-086A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1969 Oct 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Oct 14), held fixed
